load_note: Each hot path was measured 5 times, and each of those is itself the best of 3 invocations; `ms` is the minimum, with `median_ms` and `max_ms` beside it. The minimum is the least-contended observation, so a busy host can only push these numbers up - which is the direction an honest latency claim should err in. Nothing here pins CPU affinity or waits for an idle stand.
